text:
My footsteps on this street
+
+echo
+
+on another street
+
+where
+
+I hear my footsteps
+
+passing on this street
+
+where
+
+
+Only the fog is real.

translation.title: My Footsteps on This Street…
translation.editorial_note: This separately sourced witness of “Here” receives the same reviewed wording while preserving its expanded stanza spacing and first-line title.
